([[Summerlin, Nevada]]) | college = [[UNLV Runnin' Rebels basketball|UNLV]] (2015–2016) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = * Nike Hoops Summit, Jordan Brand Classic, McDonald's (All-American) (2015) * First-team All-Southwest League (2014) * First-team MaxPreps Junior All-American (2014) * 4x [[Nevada Interscholastic Activities Association|NIAA Division I champion]] (2012–2015) | medal_templates = {{MedalSport | Men's [[basketball]]}} {{MedalCountry|the {{USA}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Americas Under-18 Championship|FIBA Americas U18 Championship]]}} {{MedalGold| [[2014 FIBA Americas Under-18 Championship|2014 United States]] | [[United States men's national basketball team|National team]]}} }} '''Stephen Eric Zimmerman Jr.''' (born September 9, 1996) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[UNLV Runnin' Rebels basketball|UNLV Runnin' Rebels]] in the 2015–16 season, and one of the top high school recruits of 2015 by Rivals.com, Scout.com and ESPN. ==Early life== Stephen was born in [[Hendersonville, Tennessee]] suburb of [[Nashville, Tennessee|Nashville]], Zimmerman was raised in [[Las Vegas, Nevada]]. ==High school== Zimmerman attended Bishop Gorman High School in Las Vegas from summer 2011-12 to 2014-2015, where he led the Gaels to four-straight Nevada Division I state titles (2012, 2013, 2014, 2015). ==College Career== ===College Statistics=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2015–16 UNLV Runnin' Rebels basketball team|UNLV]] | 26 || 24 || 26.2 || .477 || .294 || .624 || 8.7 || .8 || .5 || 2.0 || 10.5 |- {{S-end}} ==Professional career== Zimmerman would be one of 59 college/postgraduate underclassmen to enter the [[2016 NBA Draft]].
